Formerly known as Extreme Dive Gaming, '''NaJin White Shield''' is a professional gaming team based in Korea. Along with [[Team OP]] they are one of the oldest teams in korea. Many of the former players are very popular players, some being known by non-Koreans for their time spent playing on the North American server. NaJin e-mFire also sponsors a second League of Legends team, [[NaJin Black Sword]] and a Tekken team.
